answer: The mesa schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the forge checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 133 effective identities must lock that capital for 50 epochs and keep it locked through every copper audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 50 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 31 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
